_what_this_is: A HOLD IS A RECORDED DECISION, NOT A PROPERTY OF A CHECK. It lives here
rather than inside any instrument for two reasons. The decision belongs to
Andrew and not to the script that trips over it; and the scripts it covers
belong to other sessions, so silencing a finding would have meant editing
somebody else's measuring tool to say the finding did not matter.
A hold NEVER hides a count. `covers` is the number of failures the hold
accounts for, and it is checked: one more failure than that and the receipt
is a failure again, because the extra one is not what anybody agreed to.
An expiry is required and it is enforced — when it lapses the check goes
red and names the hold that lapsed. An expiry nobody has watched lapse is a
promise rather than a mechanism, so this one was watched: see
Read by scripts/receipt.mjs. Delete an entry the day its reason stops
being true — an empty file is the healthy state.
